experience.fourPillarsTitle: Four Pillars Under One Warm Roof
experience.fourPillarsDesc: A purposeful blend of traditional South Indian brewing, aromatic chai rituals, collegiate study desks, and rapid document printing.
experience.ourCoffeeDesc: Steeped in traditional brass dabarah & tumbler. Chicory blend from Chikmagalur hills with hot frothed milk.
experience.regionalChaiDesc: Black tea simmered with freshly crushed ginger root, green cardamom pods, cloves, and whole spices.

experience.quietSpaceGreatCoffee: Quiet Space • Great Coffee • Warm Table

menu.menuDesc: Every cup brewed following centuries-old South Indian gravity decoction and street kettle traditions. Inquire or order directly on WhatsApp.
menu.traditionalMadrasKaapiDesc: Frothy, rich dark roast with traditional chicory blend. Poured and aerated in an authentic brass dabarah & tumbler.
menu.mysoreRoyalStrongKaapiDesc: Double-decoction extract for focused exam sessions. Intense chocolatey aroma, heavy body, balanced with sweet whole milk.
menu.icedKaapiColdBrewDesc: Chilled South Indian filter decoction shaken vigorously with condensed milk and whole milk over crushed ice.
menu.kumbakonamDegreeCoffeeDesc: Centuries-old Tamil tradition using pure cow's milk froth and the first thick drip of Chicory-Peaberry coffee decoction.
menu.filterCoffeeWithCardamomDesc: Traditional South Indian filter coffee elevated with freshly crushed green cardamom. Uplifting herbal spice meets dark roast.
menu.filterKaapiBlackDesc: Pure straight gravity-drip filter decoction without milk. Intense, aromatic, and deeply restorative for purists.
menu.houseMasalaChaiDesc: Steeped with hand-crushed fresh ginger, green cardamom pods, cloves, black pepper, and whole cinnamon bark.
menu.kolkataClayPotAdrakDesc: Fiery, soothing ginger kick brewed with premium Assam CTC tea leaves. Earthy, soothing, and restorative.
menu.kashmiriKahwaDesc: Royal green tea from Kashmir steeped with pure saffron threads, cardamom, cinnamon, and sliced almonds.
menu.icedMangoChaiDesc: Alphonso mango nectar shaken with slow-brewed black cardamom tea and cold milk over ice.
menu.noonChaiDesc: Legendary Himalayan pink tea boiled with milk, crushed cardamom, and a pinch of natural sea salt.
menu.ayurvedicHerbalInfusionDesc: Restorative herbal blend of sacred Tulsi (Holy Basil), warming ginger root, and naturally sweet licorice.

originVibe.originDesc1: Katowice is a university city buzzing with ideas, deadlines, and international minds. El Shaddai was born out of a simple need: students and academics needed a warm, unhurried space that serves real, soulful South Indian decoction coffee, alongside an ultra-dependable print desk where you can photocopy seminar readings without running across town.
originVibe.originDesc2: We deliberately do not operate a kitchen or sell food, ensuring zero frying smells, pure beverage craft, and pristine document printing. Exposed Katowice brick, warm sunlight on wide window sills, and reliable Wi-Fi offer a genuine haven between lectures.
